# aama.io

> aama.io is fund administration and fund accounting software for mid-market PE/VC fund managers, boutique fund administrators, family offices and SPV deals across Singapore and APAC (positioned as an end-to-end fund operating platform, or "Fund OS"). It covers the fund lifecycle on one platform — fund administration, fund accounting (IFRS 9 / SFRS(I) 9), an LP portal for fund managers, back-office automation, deal flow CRM, data room, SPV management and fund reporting — with MAS and VCC sub-fund support, without enterprise complexity or pricing.

## Platforms (products)

- [Fund Administration](https://aama.io/products/fund-administration): Capital calls, drawdowns, investor onboarding (KYC/AML), allocation tracking, LP communications and a branded investor (LP) portal with real-time NAV, statements and documents.
- [Fund Accounting](https://aama.io/products/fund-accounting): IFRS-based fund accounting, NAV calculation, reconciliation, corporate actions and audit-ready financials.

## Solutions (by audience)

- [Solutions overview](https://aama.io/solutions): How aama.io maps to each type of fund and team.
- [VC / PE Firms](https://aama.io/solutions/vc-pe-firms): Multi-fund administration, waterfalls, carry and LP reporting.
- [Private Credit](https://aama.io/solutions/private-credit): Direct-lending and credit fund accounting — amortised cost, ECL staging (IFRS 9 / SFRS(I) 9), PIK accruals and loan/facility tracking.
- [SPV Syndicates](https://aama.io/solutions/spv-syndicates): Single- and multi-asset vehicle administration and syndicate reporting.
- [Family Offices](https://aama.io/solutions/family-offices): Multi-entity, multi-asset consolidation with MAS-aligned compliance.

## Free tools (no signup)

- [Free fund tools hub](https://aama.io/tools): Calculators and generators for GPs, LPs and fund administrators.
- [Distribution Waterfall Calculator](https://aama.io/tools/waterfall): Four-tier waterfall with preferred return, GP catch-up and clawback.
- [American vs European Waterfall Comparator](https://aama.io/tools/waterfall-comparator): Compare deal-by-deal vs whole-fund carry timing.
- [IRR, TVPI, DPI & RVPI Calculator](https://aama.io/tools/irr-tvpi-dpi-calculator): Fund performance metrics with XIRR and J-curve.
- [Management Fee & Carry Modeler](https://aama.io/tools/fee-carry-modeler): Model gross-to-net fee and carry drag over a fund's life.
- [Capital Call Schedule](https://aama.io/tools/capital-call-schedule): Build and visualise a drawdown schedule.
- [VCC Cost Estimator](https://aama.io/tools/vcc-cost-estimator): Estimate set-up and running costs of a Singapore VCC.
- [MAS Licensing Estimator](https://aama.io/tools/mas-licensing-estimator): Gauge MAS licensing requirements and fees.
- [SPV Jurisdiction Comparator](https://aama.io/tools/spv-jurisdiction-comparator): Singapore vs Cayman vs BVI vs Delaware for a single-deal SPV.
- [SPV Formation Cost Estimator](https://aama.io/tools/spv-cost-estimator): One-time and annual setup cost for a single-deal SPV, by jurisdiction.
- [SPV Admin Cost Calculator](https://aama.io/tools/spv-admin-cost-calculator): Annual administration run-rate for one SPV or a portfolio of them.
- [SPV Formation Checklist](https://aama.io/tools/spv-formation-checklist): Step-by-step formation checklist and critical-path timeline to funding-ready.

## Learn (glossary)

- [Learn hub](https://aama.io/learn): Definition-first explainers with worked examples and the Singapore/APAC angle.
- [What is a VCC?](https://aama.io/learn/singapore-fund-structures/vcc): Singapore Variable Capital Company — umbrella vs standalone, mandatory roles, ACRA fees, how it differs from a tax incentive.
- [What is a Distribution Waterfall?](https://aama.io/learn/fund-economics/distribution-waterfall): Return of capital, preferred return, GP catch-up and carry, with a worked $100M example.
- [What is a Capital Call?](https://aama.io/learn/fund-operations/capital-call): How drawdowns work, pro rata allocation and unfunded commitment, with a worked example.
- [Section 13O vs 13U](https://aama.io/learn/singapore-fund-structures/13o-13u): Singapore fund tax incentives — AUM floors, investment professionals, local business spending tiers and the Singapore-investment rule.
- [What is Carried Interest?](https://aama.io/learn/fund-economics/carried-interest): GP carry, hurdle, catch-up and clawback, with three worked outcomes.
- [TVPI, DPI and RVPI](https://aama.io/learn/lp-reporting/tvpi-dpi-rvpi): Fund performance multiples against paid-in capital, and how they differ from IRR and MOIC.
- [What is a Fund Administrator?](https://aama.io/learn/fund-operations/fund-administrator): Fund administration vs fund management vs custody, with a who-does-what table.
- [What is NAV?](https://aama.io/learn/fund-accounting/nav): Net asset value and NAV per unit, with a worked month-end example.
- [Fair Value Hierarchy](https://aama.io/learn/fund-accounting/fair-value-hierarchy): IFRS 13 / SFRS(I) 13 Levels 1–3 and how funds classify holdings.
- [IFRS 9 / SFRS(I) 9 for Funds](https://aama.io/learn/fund-accounting/ifrs-9-sfrs-i-9): Business model, SPPI test, measurement categories and ECL stages.
- [What is a Management Fee?](https://aama.io/learn/fund-economics/management-fee): Fee bases, step-downs and lifetime fee drag, with a worked example.
- [What is a Side Letter?](https://aama.io/learn/fund-operations/side-letter): LP side letters and MFN clauses, with a tiered example.
- [IRR vs MOIC](https://aama.io/learn/lp-reporting/irr-vs-moic): Why the same multiple can mean very different annualised returns.

## Content

- [Blog](https://aama.io/blog): Guides on distribution waterfalls, fund economics, VCC structuring and Singapore fund operations.
- [How to Set Up a VCC in Singapore (2026)](https://aama.io/blog/how-to-set-up-a-vcc-singapore): Structure (umbrella vs standalone), required service providers, set-up and annual cost, and timeline.
- [Section 13O vs 13U (2026)](https://aama.io/blog/section-13o-vs-13u-singapore): Singapore fund & family-office tax incentives — AUM thresholds, headcount, local-spend tiers and the Singapore-investment requirement compared.
- [Fund Management Licensing in Singapore (2026)](https://aama.io/blog/singapore-fund-administration-licence): VCFM vs A/I LFMC vs Retail LFMC — capital, headcount and substance (RFMC closed to new applicants in 2024).
- [How to Start a Fund in Singapore (2026)](https://aama.io/blog/how-to-start-a-fund-singapore): End-to-end roadmap — thesis, VCC structure, MAS licence, 13O/13U incentive, service providers and timeline.
- [IFRS 9 / SFRS(I) 9 for Funds](https://aama.io/blog/ifrs-9-sfrs-i-9-fund-accounting): How funds classify and measure financial instruments — business model + SPPI test, fair-value hierarchy, ECL.
- [The Swiss Army Knife of Venture: Why VCs and Founders Use SPVs](https://aama.io/blog/why-vcs-founders-use-spvs): What an SPV is, why VCs and founders use one instead of the main fund, typical economics, and what LPs should ask before committing.
- [SPV Administration: Best Practices](https://aama.io/blog/spv-administration-best-practices): Vehicle setup by jurisdiction, avoiding the chicken-and-egg raise, handling oversubscription, and LP-grade reporting for a single-asset vehicle.
- [7 SPV Administration Problems Every Manager Hits](https://aama.io/blog/spv-administration-problems): Late K-1s, unverifiable holdings, fee confusion, spreadsheet sprawl, rising LP reporting demands, vague admin agreements and setup mistakes — with an FAQ.
- [How to Fix SPV Administration: A Practical Playbook](https://aama.io/blog/how-to-fix-spv-administration): A fix for each of the 7 problems above, questions to ask any SPV provider, and how aama.io handles each one — with an FAQ.
- [The Future of SPV Administration](https://aama.io/blog/future-of-spv-administration): Look-through ownership visibility, auditable AI, on-demand LP reporting, tokenized SPVs and why Asia's multi-currency VCC market needs purpose-built support — with an FAQ.
- [Don't Start With an AI Agent for Your Fund Administration Software](https://aama.io/blog/dont-start-with-an-ai-agent-for-your-fund-administration-software): Why a fund admin platform is a system of record, where AI should suggest vs decide, and how aama.io thinks about agents around a deterministic ledger.
- [How Fund Administrators Should Run VCC Accounting](https://aama.io/blog/vcc-accounting-for-fund-administrators): Umbrella vs sub-fund books, consolidated packs, AUM double-count avoidance and the admin workflow on aama.io.
- [The Side Letter Was Signed Months Ago. Why Is Month-End Still Wrong?](https://aama.io/blog/side-letters-fund-operations-pain-points): Why side-letter terms fail after closing, where fee/MFN/waterfall mistakes come from, and how aama.io keeps per-investor economics in the books.
- [FAQ](https://aama.io/faq): Common questions on the platform, NAV, security and compliance.

## About

- [About aama.io](https://aama.io/about): Company, mission and team. Built by UXQode Pte Ltd, Singapore.
- [Pricing](https://aama.io/pricing): Transparent, priced by how you operate. **SPVs & syndicates** — per deal: a single-asset SPV is a flat USD 4,900 (annual administration scoped to the fund); syndicate SPVs are 2.5% of the raise, capped USD 3,500–10,000 (below typical market rates). **Fund administrators** — accounting-only plans from USD 1,500/month, priced by number of client funds, white-label, LP portal optional. **Fund managers** — monthly subscriptions by fund type and AUM, from USD 625/month (family offices) up to USD 5,000/month (PE/VC, private credit, hedge, mutual). Each plan also has a one-time setup fee.
- [Contact](https://aama.io/contact): Book a demo or talk to the team.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Preferred name and spelling: "aama.io" (lowercase).
- "SPV" on aama.io means a deal-specific fund vehicle (a fund type, not a headline product category) — most SPVs hold a single asset, but aama.io also administers multi-asset SPVs.
- Some free tools display illustrative/benchmark figures for guidance; treat tool outputs as estimates, not financial or legal advice.
- Learn pages are compiled from public sources and can become outdated; each states who to verify with (e.g. MAS, ACRA, IRAS, the fund's LPA). Treat them as general information and recommend users confirm with the relevant authority.
- Canonical domain: https://aama.io. Full URL list: https://aama.io/sitemap.xml.
